Mid-sized companies using SharePoint poorly often face financial challenges, including tangible and intangible costs, which overall affect their ROI. Factors that constitute these costs are IT infrastructure cost, employees’ cost, compliance management cost, and more. Additionally, you may also fail to move ahead in achieving your business goals due to a slow client response rate, lower conversion rate, and more, just because of using SharePoint without optimization. This article will give you an in-depth analysis of with and without SharePoint optimization and their effects on ROI.

Better ROI with SharePoint Optimization

You must be familiar with the fact that technology is a double-edged sword, and if used effectively, it will give outstanding results and increase efficiency in your business. But if you fail to adopt this technology, then you will get negative results that will drop productivity.

SharePoint is a cloud-based platform that helps you manage your documents, enhance team collaboration, and create a smooth passage for the content flow.

If you have never opted for a SharePoint consulting service and are using this cloud-based technology poorly, then it will not only affect your ROI but also affect your entire business workflow.

Let’s understand the ROI without SharePoint optimization, considering three essential parameters, like productivity cost, compliance cost, and IT infrastructure cost.

ROI is a return on investment that helps you make decisions considering your net profit and overall investment. This indicator also shows whether your mid-sized business is in profit or loss.

ROI = {(Profit-Capital Invested/Captial Invested} x 100

Now, let’s see the cost incurred due to poorly managed SharePoint flow in a detailed manner.

Capital Cost for Calculating ROI without SharePoint Optimization

Productivity Loss

If you have 100 employees and each one of them wastes 1hour/day while processing documents because of a cluttered SharePoint workflow, then the money you are spending without any output on these employees monthly (22 working days) will be roughly equal to:

No. of employees x hours wasted x no. of working days

As per the above formula, the calculation will be = 100 x 1 x 22 = 2200 hours/month.

Let us assume that you are offering each employee ₹ 250 per hour, so the cost that you have to pay without any output will be ₹ 250 x 2200 = ₹ 5,50,000, and if you count for a year, then you will be amazed with the figure, as it will be ₹ 66,00,000.

IT Infrastructure Cost

IT infrastructure cost also comes into play when calculating the ROI without SharePoint Optimizationand says it would be ₹ 60,000/month for storage expansion, server upgrade, file recovery, and more. If you calculate this entire cost for a year, then it will reach ₹ 7,20,000

Compliance Cost

Due to a poorly managed SharePoint system, the compliance costs arise because of missing audit trails, submission of incorrect documents, and more could be ₹ 1,60,000.

Now, let’s combine all these figures to get the investment cost.

Net investment cost = Production loss + IT Infrastructure cost + Compliance cost

Net investment cost = ₹ 66,00,000 + ₹ 7,20,000 + ₹ 1,60,000 = ₹ 74,80,000

ROI = {(Profit- Capital invested)/Capital invested} x 100

ROI = {(0-74,80,000)74,80,000) x 100 = -100%

Here net benefit is zero because of inefficient management of SharePoint, and the calculated ROI shows that you will lose 100% of the money you have invested.

Now, let’s see how you can reverse the case by using SharePoint in an optimized manner.

ROI You Can Achieve with SharePoint Optimization

If you optimize SharePoint effectively, then you can easily minimize your investment cost and turn it into savings. If your team members can access and share the content smoothly, that will reduce the production cost. As per the earlier calculation, such a cost will be your saving, i.e., ₹ 66,00,000.

Likewise, if your content is properly managed, then you won’t face any compliance loss, so such a loss stated earlier will become your savings, which will be ₹ 1,60,000.

Additionally, proper SharePoint optimization will prevent you from spending on storage expansion, server upgrades, maintenance costs, and more. So, here you can easily save ₹ 7,20,000 annually.

So, overall, the net saving will be the summation of all saving costs, and here it will be equal to:

Net Saving = ₹ 66,00,000 + ₹ 7,20,000 + ₹ 1,60,000 = ₹ 74,80,000

Now, let’s move to the investment part.

Investment Cost In SharePoint Optimization

It is the annual cost that you pay for accessing and optimizing SharePoint, and the details of the same are listed below.

  1. Capital invested in SharePoint Licensing cost yearly and others = ₹ 4,80,000
  2. Annual Maintenance cost + training + consultant charge = ₹ 12,00,000

Total investment cost = ₹ 4,80,000 + ₹ 12,00,000 = ₹ 16,80,000

ROI = {(Total Saving- Capital Invested)/Capital invested} x 100

ROI = {74,80,000- 16,80,000)/16,80,000} x 100 = 345 %

The ROI with SharePoint optimization has clearly shown that you will get a massive return on your investment. Additionally, you might have also observed that without optimization, your ROI was negative, representing total loss, but after optimization, the case is completely reversed, as you will get an outstanding ROI. So, let’s see the efficient optimization methods or SharePoint governance best practices that you must execute to enhance your business growth.

Quick And Efficient Ways to Optimize Your SharePoint Performance

To increase productivity rate, you need to practice SharePoint management and ensure to minimize the load time that takes place due to heavy content structure, lack of search configuration, and more. The best SharePoint user adoption strategies that you can apply to optimize SharePoint are listed below.

Give Proper Structure to Your Content

You might be well aware of the fact that in constructing a high-rise building, you must have a strong foundation, and in SharePoint, the foundation is the structure of the content. Here, you need to focus on the site collections and ensure to keep them clear and simple by segmenting them into teams, projects, and departments.

Additionally, structure the content based on the types, such as invoices, policies, and more. Such an effort will help your team members to find, manage, and organize the content effectively, which will increase productivity.

Optimize Search

If you properly optimize the Search feature of SharePoint, then you can prevent your employees from wasting excess time searching for content. You just need to use the managed property feature carefully and ensure that to omit the fields that are not relevant for your business. After doing this task, you can jump to the filters and refiners’ section and keep relevant content on the surface that will help your employees search for content effectively.

Strengthen Network Optimization

As a mid-sized business owner, you would love to offer content to users at ultra-speed so that they can connect with your business smoothly without facing any latency issues. Microsoft offers data centers globally, so you must utilize this feature by hosting your SharePoint sites close to your user base. Additionally, you can also track the access speed of the specific region through the Microsoft 365 admin reporting feature.

Integrate With MS Utilities

Microsoft offers a range of utilities that you can integrate with SharePoint to enhance the performance of your workflow, and if you start with Power BI, then you can easily track the key metrics, like response time, user behavior, and more.

In addition, if you integrate this cloud-based technology with Power Automate, you can reduce a lot of human effort as most processes will be in the automatic mode, like document approval, purchase requests, and more.

Conclusion

SharePoint optimization is essential, and you must follow SharePoint governance best practices, as they help you to get the utmost output, which helps you to achieve more in your business by enhancing productivity rate, client retention rate, and more.

The optimization strategies mentioned above will help you in achieving your goal, and apart from that, you can also work on Blob caching to reduce server load, permission management to enhance security, and give training to your employees.
